name: プラン特典を一行で示すアップグレード案内バナー
prompt: Second attempt: correct the wrapped copy from the first candidate. The reference banner's outer shape and colors are authoritative. Produce one 1027 x 66 px banner with every word and icon on exactly one horizontal line, never two lines. Use a small, compact Japanese UI sans-serif, about 14 px at final size, and reduce its size further if needed so the full group fits within x=50..977. Keep readable spacing and vertically center the line. Use these concise Japanese phrases in this order: bold 「今すぐアップグレード」, small yellow ✨, regular 「プロジェクト無制限 ・ 大容量ストレージ ・ ユーザー無制限」, small yellow ✨, then bold underlined 「プランを見る」. This preserves the three benefits and the plan-options link while fitting a single line. Keep the source's pale-blue fill, thin vivid-blue rounded outline and 9 px corner radius. No shadows, extra page area, line breaks, or added content.
reviewNotes: 日本語で「今すぐアップグレード」、3特典、プランを見るリンクを一行に配置。枠線・角丸・薄青背景は原図に近く、全内容が内側に収まる。翻訳文の全幅は原図より約48px広いが左右に余白を残し、目視で確認済み。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

inputReferences.role: first candidate; correct line wrapping and retain translated content
